description: Due-diligence facts on a DeFi protocol from DeFi Llama, by slug or name (e.g. 'aave-v3', 'Aave', 'Jupiter Lend'): TVL now and its 1- and 7-day change, TVL split by chain, category, audit count and audit links, past exploits recorded against it (date, amount lost and returned, classification and technique), and flags such as rugged or forked-from. A parent name covers all its versions. Neutral facts, not a safety rating: audits don't mean a protocol is safe. Fails (and is not charged) if the protocol isn't found or DeFi Llama doesn't answer. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.
